newsitem.title: PERU: Peru foreign minister Tudela resigns-gov't sources.
newsitem.headline: Peru foreign minister Tudela resigns-gov't sources.

text.p: Francisco Tudela has had his resignation offer accepted by President Alberto Fujimori, foreign ministry sources said Wednesday.
The sources said Tudela had resigned because of the
recent political difficulties facing the government.
Tudela's resignation, which has been widely rumored in
local media, could not be immediately confirmed by official government spokesmen.
Tudela, 41, a widely respected and popular member of

the government, narrowly escaped alive from the besieged Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, where he was held hostage for four months with 71 other captives until a spectacular military rescue on April 22.
